title: Synquest composition configuration
description: VEC-B2.3 draft — JSON/YAML schema for synquest.metadata, synquest.vector, synquest.fusion, synquest.execution. Forward-looking: Java binding lands with B2 adapters/B4 modes; this schema freezes the key space now. Version 0.1.0-draft.

provider.description: VEC-B2.1 metadata.* namespace: the storage/lexical stack.
VEC-B2.1 vector.* namespace. Unset in config means default-to-metadata (VEC-B2.2); explicit here.

endpoint_ref.description: Secret-bearing endpoint by ${VAR} reference only (.env.default contract); absent for in-process providers.

method.description: Fusion method. Only rrf exists today; the enum grows, never renames.

mode.description: Deployment default; per-query override via SearchRequest.executionMode (VEC-B4.2).
